_about: Independent Media Network (imnetwork.com.au): website subscription for small businesses. Edited by chat. Prices ex-GST (IMN is GST-registered). Decided by Simon 16 Nov 2026: $99/mo, Stripe billing, T&Cs drafted. 17 Nov 2026: setup fee scrapped ($0, normal 0, promo off) and no lock-in contract (service first); positioning 'your website, under control': daily checks, confidence-at-a-glance dashboard, the IMN brain (lessons shared across every site). ai.title: The IMN brain: every site makes yours better
paragraphs: Every site we run, from travel guides to pay calculators to local businesses, feeds what it learns into one system. When a fix works on one site, like a page title that earns more Google clicks or a slow page made fast, we check every client's site for the same win.
So you get the lessons from every industry we work in, not just your own. We share lessons, never your data: your numbers and your customers' details stay private to you.
A person runs every job. Simon plans your site with you, signs off every change and answers your emails himself. Nothing goes live without a human checking it.

change: A change round is a small update to your site, up to 30 minutes of work: new or edited text, swapping photos, updating prices or opening hours, or adding a section to an existing page. Send your edits together in one email. Unused rounds don't carry over. Extra pages beyond your first 5 are $99 + GST each, once. A redesign is quoted first.

faq.a: The website is free, and it's yours to keep. If you want us to run it for you (your own domain, a dashboard, daily checks, Google upkeep and 2 change rounds a month), that's $99 + GST a month ($108.90 inc GST), charged by card. No setup fee, no lock-in.

faq.q: Is the free website really free? What's the catch?
faq.a: No catch. The free site is a simple site built from what you already publish, on an IMN address, with a small "Website by IMN" link at the bottom. It doesn't include changes, support or a dashboard. Plenty of owners ask us to run it later. If you don't, that's fine.

Two promises. We put your site live within 7 days of your go-ahead (counted from when we have your details and access to your web address), or your first month is free. And if you're not happy for any reason in your first 30 days, tell us and we refund your first month in full. It's one refund of your first month per business, whichever applies.

A small update, up to 30 minutes of work: new or edited text, swapping photos, updating prices or opening hours, or a new section on an existing page. Send your edits together in one email. Extra rounds are $50 + GST. A brand-new page or a redesign is quoted first. Need more than 5 pages? Each extra page is $99 + GST, once, and stays looked after in your plan.

No. It's month to month: cancel by email before your next billing date and you won't be charged again. We'd rather keep you because the service is good than because of a contract. Full details are in our terms.

faq.q: What does the confidence light mean?
faq.a: Green: all good, nothing needs you. Amber: we've spotted something and we're on it. Red: we need a quick decision from you, and we'll be in touch with a plan. Underneath you can see exactly why.
You own your domain name and your content. If you leave, we send you your site files and help you move your domain.

faq.q: Do I need a domain name?
faq.a: Not for the free site: it lives on an IMN address like yourbusiness.imnetwork.com.au. To use your own address like yourbusiness.com.au, choose the plan. Domains are bought in your business's name, usually about $20 to $30 a year from the registrar. We'll help you buy one, or connect the one you have.

faq.q: Do you use AI to build sites?
faq.a: Yes, for the heavy lifting: drafting, daily checks and quick edits. Lessons from every site we run make the system smarter for all of them. A person plans your site with you, signs off every change and answers your emails.
Only if you choose the plan. The free site is never charged. On the plan, your first monthly payment is taken when your site goes live on your own domain.
Melbourne. We work with businesses anywhere in Australia, by email, phone or video call.

faq.q: How do I know you're a real business?
faq.a: We're Independent Media Network Pty Ltd, a Melbourne company run by Simon Farrugia (ABN 89 640 199 935, which you can check on the government's ABN Lookup). We never ask for passwords or card details by email, payments go through Stripe, there's no lock-in, and every site we run for ourselves is listed on our sites page.

A home page and key pages built from what you already publish: your services, area, hours and how to reach you, in your logo and colours, made for phones. We also show you privately what we found: gaps in how you show up online and what people near you search for.

glance.title: Know it's all working, at a glance
paragraphs: Most business owners have no idea if their website is helping or quietly broken. Your dashboard answers that in one look: green means all good, amber means we're watching something, red means we need a quick decision from you.
Underneath sit the checks we run for you: broken pages, speed, Google basics, how often Google shows you and how many people visit. This is the real panel for one of our own sites.
